name: electric-blue-sequin-selfie
image_purpose: Create a polished dressing-room mirror selfie showcasing reflective sequin fashion and luxury styling.

prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic high-end fashion mirror selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with jet-black Hollywood-wave hair, natural porcelain-toned skin texture, soft feline-shaped eyes and a confident neutral expression; wearing an opaque electric-blue metallic sequin mini dress with a matching statement choker and refined jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated mirror selfie with legs crossed naturally, one arm resting on a vanity and the other holding a white smartphone in an orange case; purple textured walls, ornate gold-framed artwork, plush beige seating and a white-clothed table in an opulent dressing room.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft-focus warm indoor light with golden-hour glow, diffused shadows and high-specular highlights across sequins and jewelry; confident, luxurious and sophisticated mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Eye-level mirror perspective, 35mm, f/1.8, medium waist-up framing, 8K detail, realistic skin, sequin micro-detail and ray-traced reflections.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic dressing-room mirror selfie of a clearly adult original woman with jet-black Hollywood waves wearing an opaque electric-blue metallic sequin dress, matching choker and refined jewelry, seated with a white smartphone, purple textured walls, ornate gold-framed artwork and plush beige seating, warm diffused light, realistic reflections, 8K fashion editorial detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, transparent dress, logos, text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, plastic skin, broken reflections
